description: Author the canonical principles document for the routines-app scenario. Principles to land (from the 2026-04-23 vision walk): flexibility ladder (markdown -> structured list -> light DAG -> rich graph; explicitly not BPMN-2.0-the-spec); routines-as-resource-not-app (no user-facing build-your-own workflow surface); one-opinionated-app shape rejected in favor of branded-scenarios-on-top pattern; library / executor are distinct UX surfaces sharing data; routine steps may invoke any scenario CLI (composition over fixed step schema) with an explicit versioning story required before scale; validation separate from authoring (feedback / agent review / evidence). The principles stay stable; per-version OTs stay honest to what is being built. Deliverable: principles.md under the routines-app initiative folder, referenced from the scenario README once v0 ships.
